128 MB RAM · 0.1 CPU",exact:true});await free.waitFor({timeout:20000});await page.waitForTimeout(900);const group=page.getByRole('radiogroup').filter({has:free});if(await group.count()!==1)throw new Error('Ambiguous plan group');const radios=group.getByRole('radio');const mutations=[];const handler=request=>{try{const body=request.postDataJSON();for(const q of (Array.isArray(body)?body:[body]))if(/^\s*mutation\b/.test(q?.query||''))mutations.push({operationName:q.operationName??null,variables:q.variables??null,query:q.query})}catch{}};page.on('request',handler);const measure=async()=>({at:new Date().toISOString(),group:await group.ariaSnapshot(),radios:await radios.evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>({text:e.textContent,tag:e.tagName,checked:e.getAttribute('aria-checked'),tabIndex:e.tabIndex,disabled:e.disabled,active:e===document.activeElement}))),groupLabels:await group.evaluate(e=>({ariaLabel:e.getAttribute('aria-label'),labelledBy:e.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'),role:e.getAttribute('role')}))});try{await free.focus();const before=await measure();await free.press('ArrowRight');await page.waitForTimeout(150);const right=await measure();await group.screenshot({path:'qa-a449-keyvalue-arrow-desktop.png'});await free.focus();await free.press('ArrowDown');await page.waitForTimeout(150);const down=await measure();await free.focus();await free.press('Tab');const tab=await measure();const starter=radios.nth(1);await starter.focus();await starter.press('Space');await page.waitForTimeout(200);const spaceControl=await measure();await free.focus();await free.press('Space');await page.waitForTimeout(200);const restored=await measure();return{at:new Date().toISOString(),surface:"keyvalue",viewport:{width:1440,height:1000},url:page.url(),before,right,down,tab,spaceControl,restored,mutations,createEnabled:await page.getByRole('button',{name:"Create Key Value Instance",exact:true}).isEnabled()}}finally{page.off('request',handler)}}
